Tuning System Kind

  • CURIE: gmeow:TuningSystemKind
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TuningSystemKind
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/music

The kind of a tuning system, drawn from an open value vocabulary of individuals (equal division, just intonation, well temperament, instrument-relative, etc.). Never subclassed (Principle 9).

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:TuningSystemKind as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
